# 🧮 Vector Search & ANN Libraries Directory

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue) ![libraries](https://img.shields.io/badge/libraries-15-green) ![open%20source](https://img.shields.io/badge/open%20source-15-brightgreen) ![categories](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-3-purple) [![CI](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/vector-search-ann-libs-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/vector-search-ann-libs-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> A curated, machine-readable directory of **approximate-nearest-neighbor (ANN) / vector-search libraries** — the embeddable indexes and algorithms (HNSW graphs, trees, quantization) that power similarity search.

Distinct from vector *databases* (storage engines/services) and *embedding models* (which produce the vectors): these are the libraries you embed to build and query an index. Ships a small CLI to search/filter/export.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .                # stdlib-only; no runtime deps
annlib-dir list                 # list all
annlib-dir list --category graph_hnsw
annlib-dir search quantization  # search name/org/note/tags
annlib-dir export --format csv > ann-libs.csv
annlib-dir generate             # regenerate this README
```

## Directory

### Graph-Based (HNSW) Libraries (6)

| Library | Org | Source | License | Notes |
|---------|-----|--------|---------|-------|
| [hnswlib](https://github.com/nmslib/hnswlib) | nmslib | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Header-only HNSW implementation (C++/Python). |
| [JVector](https://github.com/datastax/jvector) | DataStax | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Java graph index with HNSW-style layers and Vamana search graphs. |
| [NGT](https://github.com/yahoojapan/NGT) | Yahoo Japan | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Graph & tree-based ANN library (Neighborhood Graph and Tree). |
| [nmslib](https://github.com/nmslib/nmslib) | nmslib | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Non-Metric Space Library — fast ANN across many methods. |
| [usearch](https://github.com/unum-cloud/usearch) | Unum | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Compact, SIMD-accelerated HNSW engine across many languages. |
| [Voyager](https://github.com/spotify/voyager) | Spotify | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | HNSW-based nearest-neighbor library (Python & Java). |

## Choosing one (rules of thumb)

- **Default workhorse:** FAISS (IVF/PQ/HNSW, CPU & GPU).
- **Lightweight HNSW:** hnswlib, usearch, Voyager.
- **Static, memory-mapped trees:** Annoy.
- **Billion-scale on disk:** DiskANN.
- **Pure-Python / Numba:** PyNNDescent.
